answer: Sybil resistance rests on one mechanism: bonded, hardware-attested identity. Each agent registers an enclave-held key signing a device attestation, and the registry accepts one identity per attestation only with a slashable stake behind it. Enclave keys cannot be copied, so an attacker wanting ten thousand identities must buy that many devices and stake them all: faking a population costs linearly with its size. Double voting brings a fraud proof that slashes the stake, revokes the attestation and quarantine-ripples every linked key, so the reef of forged accounts collapses. No velvet way.
